subject: maths
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar graph shows the number of shirts manufactured (in thousands) by a company over five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7da049ff820118b321d88e8c164535676a1fa299cc4628a5515232ab865a7fc9.png] 

What is the percentage decrement in the production of shirts in the year 2015 as compared to 2014 (correct up to two decimals)?
solution:
**Calculations:**

The production of shirts in the year 2014

= 28 thousand 

The production of shirts in the year 2015

= 20 thousand

Decrement in the production of shirts in the year 2015 as compared to the production of the year 2014,

= 28 - 20

= 8 thousand

Percentage decreament,

= (8)/(28) × 100

= 28.57

**Hence, The Required percentage value is 28.57%.**
